propositions: A model class configured with provider='bedrock' and canonical versioned Bedrock id containing a colon is silently downgraded to unqualified string, losing the configured provider
The bug occurs because _resolve_target tests colon presence to detect already-qualified strings, but Bedrock's version suffixes contain colons unrelated to provider qualification
An explicitly configured provider argument to _resolve_target must be checked first before scanning the model string, to prevent any punctuation in the model id from overriding it
Two independent colon-scan implementations in _resolve_target and infer_provider must be unified into a single shared function to prevent divergent behavior on the same inputs
A conflicting configured-provider and inline-qualifier pair must raise rather than silently pick a winner, since either choice discards an explicit instruction
The provider decision must not regress unversioned aliases and already-qualified strings, which must continue to resolve unchanged
